verdict.rationale: Ramp documents an official MCP server ('Ramp MCP') letting users connect AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to query data and take actions, with a dedicated support article and docs page confirming it exists and works (e.g., locking a card, finding missing receipts). This is corroborated by both first-party docs and a support-article walkthrough with concrete example prompts. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Ramp) hands-on review of the MCP server's reliability.
